name: Question 6
problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 6 & 11 & 0 \\ 2 & -4 & -5 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 6 & 9 \\ 0 & 2 & 9 & 8\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & -7 & -27 \\ 2 & 0 & 7 & 18 \\ 0 & 2 & 6 & 9 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrices $A$ and $B$ above. By applying three matrix elementary row operations 

- ${R}_{1}:=…$
- ${R}_{2}:=…$
- ${R}_{4}:={R}_{4}-{R}_{3}$

each of the form ${R}_{i}:={R}_{i}+k{R}_{3},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the missing elementary row operations?

Question 6
?

A=[261102−4−5002690298],B=[20−7−27207180269003−1]

Consider the matrices A and B above. By applying three matrix elementary row operations

  1. R1:=…
  2. R2:=…
  3. R4:=R4−R3
each of the form Ri:=Ri+kR3, the matrix A can be transformed into the matrix B. What are the missing elementary row operations?

a
R1:=R1+3R3 and R2:=R2−2R3
b
R1:=R1−2R3 and R2:=R2+3R3
c
R1:=R1−3R3 and R2:=R2−2R3
d
R1:=R1−3R3 and R2:=R2+2R3
e
R1:=R1+3R3 and R2:=R2+2R3
Submit
